title: Ventas Chairman and CEO Debra A. Cafaro to Receive Cyrus McCormick Making History Award for Historic Corporate Achievement
summary: Ventas, Inc. (NYSE: VTR) today announced that Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Debra A. Cafaro will receive the Cyrus McCormick Making History Award for Historic Corporate Achievement at the Chicago History Museum’s 32nd Annual Making History Awards this evening. The Cyrus McCormick Making History Award for Historic Corporate Achievement recognizes business leaders and organizations whose work has made enduring contributions to Chicago’s economic and civic life. Under Cafaro’s leadership, Ventas has grown into one of the world’s leading enterprises at the center of the longevity economy, with ownership of over 1,400 properties and a mission focused on serving a large and growing aging population.
